flags.why: This is a derogatory description that can insult someone when applied to them.
The receive or collect sense is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label ([dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/lãnh)).
An ultrasound machine is 'máy siêu âm', whereas 'siêu âm' here names the scan.
